headline: Wayne Rooney wouldn't 'feel comfortable' accepting Premier League medal if Man City stripped of titles
description: Wayne Rooney has said he wouldn't feel comfortable being handed another Premier League medal if Manchester City are stripped of their title win in the 2011-12 season.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool keen on Real Madrid midfielder Tchouaméni
description: Liverpool have maintained contact with the representatives of Real Madrid midfielder Aurélien Tchouaméni. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Patrick Vieira reveals Manchester United, Sir Alex Ferguson talks during Arsenal stint
description: Patrick Vieira has revealed he had the opportunity to join Manchester United as a player.

headline: Joe Hart: I believe Man City chairman claims that club are innocent
description: Former Man City goalkeeper Joe Hart has said he trusts club chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak's claims that the club will "prove their innocence" despite the expectation they will be found guilty of the majority of breaches of Premier League financial rules.

headline: Which Premier League players got injured in the international break?
description: All the latest news and updates on Premier League stars injuries during the first international break of the 2026-2027 club season

headline: Man City CEO adamant legal battle with the Premier League is not over - reports
description: Manchester City chief executive Ferran Soriano has told his fellow European club bosses the already lengthy legal battle with the Premier League will take "a lot more time" to conclude.
